opening.argument: The material is plainly structured as a documentary-style account of George Michael's music and career. Its title identifies a film, while the discussion of his singing, the recollection of “Faith” on MTV, and commentary on how his videos changed the medium establish an entertainment and cultural focus. Concert footage and interview imagery reinforce that presentation. References to albums and listening options through named music services remain ordinary context for music coverage, not a financial offer or deceptive transaction.

citations.quote: He's a proper, proper, proper singer.
All I remember is Faith being played 50 times a day on MTV.
